author: Disney
description:
What if Cruella and Anita had grown up together and were friends at school? 

A reimagined darker prequel story of Disney’s One Hundred and One Dalmatians told through silhouette and animation. 

Inspired by The New York Times Best-Selling Series, A Twisted Tale, available wherever books are sold. 

Production by: Wild Comet Media, Lucy Animation Studio, Formidable Studio, Animales del Sur.
